column1: # The ONLY place an exemption can be granted. It lives in the central repository,
# so adding a row is a reviewed pull request here — never a claim the audited
# repository makes about itself. `scripts/repo-hygiene.sh` reads this file from
# its own checkout, so nothing in the repository under audit can influence it.
#   repository   owner/name, exactly as `github.repository` reports it
#   class        one of: archived | mirror | generated | bootstrap
#   review-by    YYYY-MM-DD; past this date the row stops exempting
#   reason       one sentence a reviewer can check
# An unrecognised class, a missing reason, or a missing review-by date is a
# FAULT: the check fails closed rather than honouring a row nobody agreed to.
